entries.39ae79ba7ca3982c: This division plans, designs and sells food and other packaging materials, centered on rice bags. It handles a range of rice bags, including the Zipper Side-Gusset Roll GZR, a bag designed to work with fully automatic weighing and packaging machines, fully original rice bags and half-made design rice bags, and it is also advancing the development and sale of environmentally friendly products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥4,177 million.
entries.3f4113fd94ed6381: Rice-milling plants of JA Zen-Noh system wholesalers, rice wholesalers and others
entries.5ebdb5ec6d1f6ed9: It handles machines that produce air cushioning and paper cushioning materials, with dedicated film and paper materials, and gummed tape feeding machines and case sealing machines with dedicated gummed tape materials, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥816 million.
entries.7be90547243231f4: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Packwell Co., Ltd. and BJT JAPAN LLC. It purchases and sells packing machinery and packing materials that address packing challenges such as "wrapping," "filling" and "sealing," and provides services such as product introduction support and maintenance. It purchases products from overseas manufacturers and sells them to end users, either directly or through sales companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥916 million.
entries.7ea1a875ac094a36: This division plans, develops, manufactures and sells weighing and packaging machinery, centered on automatic weighing and packaging machines for rice. It plans and develops the high-speed packer Nexus, which combines speed and ease of operation, the Super Intelligent Packer SIP-110, and the foreign matter removal device Tōsenbō, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,018 million.
entries.989dc0dfb7dcd0e4: It handles packing machinery, including cushioning material production machines and gummed tape feeding and case sealing machines, and also provides services such as introduction support and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥99 million.
entries.9b3e1beaf786c547: Businesses that handle foods other than rice, fertilizers, pet-related products and other goods
entries.a138d6ea5b079efd: A company with a packaging-related business and a logistics packing business, centered on packaging materials for rice and automatic weighing and packaging machines.
entries.ac50b3d83e6b6336: This is the main business, consisting of the packaging materials division and the packaging machinery division. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥6,195 million. Packaging materials are purchased after the company orders their manufacture from consolidated subsidiary Yamaha Insatsu Co., Ltd. and outside manufacturers, and packaging machinery is purchased after the company orders machines it has planned and developed from manufacturing subcontractors and parts manufacturers.
